info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Labels-v4-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Labels Retrieval API allows users to access detailed label information for logistics shipments. By leveraging this endpoint, businesses can efficiently retrieve and manage labels necessary for shipping processes. This API serves logistic managers and operations staff who need to generate or verify shipment labels. Typical use cases include integrating label information into tracking systems or ensuring compliance with shipping standards.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the label details for a specific shipment. It provides the necessary information for tracking and managing your shipments effectively.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving shipment labels. This body contains the necessary parameters for generating the label, formatted as JSON. Ensure that all required fields are provided to obtain the correct label details.

200.description: Request was successful and shipment label data retrieved.

ListLogisticsShipmentsLabelsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to shipment labels.
